column21: RESTRAINED: Frozen to the floor (DC 19 Str to break).
IGNITED: Purges heat. Target burns for 1d6 fire/turn.
GRAPPLED: Vents core into target. Takes 2d10 fire/turn while grabbed.
VULNERABLE: Freezing rain. Vulnerability to Cold for 1 turn.
FLY/DASH: Steps on falling rain/steam to fly 30 ft without provoking attacks.
BUFF: Umbrella deals +2d6 extra fire damage this turn.
BLINDED: Vapor to the eyes. Blinds for 1 turn (DC 19 Con Save).
OBSCURED: Vents steam. Area is heavily obscured for 1 turn.
PRONE: Brutal vent. Automatically triggers Thermal Shock.
PUSHED: Thermobaric explosion. Triggers Thermal Shock.
DEFENSE: +4 AC against 1 attack, gains +15 Heat.
COUNTER: Nullifies enemy Cold/Fire spell. Gains +20 Heat.
